name: The Adventures of Tintin - The Game

description: ``The Adventures of Tintin ★The Secret of the Unicorn★'' is a much-talked-about movie based on the popular Belgian comic ``The Adventures of Tintin'', which was conceived by director Steven Spielberg for 30 years. This is the director's first 3D movie turned into a complete action game! You can easily enjoy the power of 3D movies on your Nintendo 3DS.
